original_prompt: A clear ice cube on a shallow plate gradually shrinks while a puddle of water grows around it.

initial_condition.description: Warm ambient sunlight supplies the heat that melts the ice.

pre_event_image_prompt: A realistic fixed close photograph of one clear, sharply edged ice cube centered on one dry shallow white plate in a warm sunlit room. The cube is fully solid and large enough to track, with crisp corners and no visible meltwater yet. Soft sunlight and warm reflections make the heat source visually credible without changing the cube's initial state. Keep the plate and all of the future puddle area inside one uncluttered frame. One continuous 1280x704 landscape frame.
text_policy: pre_event_image_prompt is used verbatim for image generation
